snippet.title: Where's My Red Ball Trailer
snippet.description:
Please help a lonely, sad cat find the hidden red ball.

Where’s My Red Ball? is a point-and-click puzzle game where you search for the one red ball hidden in a different way in every stage.
Open boxes, move objects, look for clues, and find the exact red ball the cat is waiting for.

But this cat is very particular.
If the ball is dirty, dented, too small, or even slightly wrong, it will not be enough.

Solve light, clever puzzles and slowly uncover the hidden story behind why the cat keeps searching for the red ball.

Play the demo and add Where’s My Red Ball? to your wishlist on Steam.

Steam Demo Page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3984750/_/
